name: Wave and Rock
overview: Two young couples named "Sadaf" and "Chavosh", who have married after many problems, decide to travel to the island of Kish for their honeymoon. In the meantime, due to arriving late at the airport, they miss the plane and at "Sadaf"'s suggestion, the two decide to take the train to Kish; but at the train station, they pick up "Chavosh" and in the meantime, a wanted person encounters them and...
